cards.audioText: What assistance or support do you need from ATC in case of emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 在紧急情况下，您需要ATC提供哪些帮助或支持？
cards.referenceText:
In an emergency, we need ATC to coordinate fire services, medical assistance, and arrange shuttle buses to transport passengers to the terminal. Also, clear communication for priority landing, airspace coordination, and updated weather info are crucial.
紧急情况下，需 ATC 协调消防、医疗救援，安排摆渡巴士送乘客到航站楼。同时，还需 ATC 保障优先降落、协调空域、提供最新气象信息等清晰通讯支持 。

cards.audioText: Who should be the last one to leave the aircraft in case of emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 在紧急情况下，谁应该是最后一个离开飞机的人？
cards.referenceText:
I think the captain should be the last one to leave the aircraft in case of emergency, because he is responsible for all the passengers and crew members on board.
我认为在紧急情况下，机长应该是最后一个离开飞机的人，因为他对机上的所有乘客和机组人员负责。

cards.audioText: What may cause the pilot to go around / Execute missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么可能导致飞行员复飞/执行复飞？
cards.referenceText:
here are some reasons for going around. For example, runway not in sight at minimums, encountering wind shear, localized weather fluctuations, and no proper contact for landing, and so on.
复飞有这些原因，比如在最低标准时看不到跑道、遭遇风切变、局部气象波动，以及无法建立合适着陆衔接，等等 。

cards.audioText: Under what circumstances may the aircraft suffer structural damage? Can you name a few?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么情况下，飞机可能会遭受结构性损坏？你能列举几个吗？
cards.referenceText:
There are some reasons for structural damage. For example, make a hard landing, bird strike, lightning strike, severe turbulence, explosion and so on.
结构损坏的原因有很多。例如，硬着陆、鸟击、雷击、严重湍流、爆炸等。

Structural damage can be caused by bird strike, FOD ingestion, lightning strike, severe turbulence, ground collision, tail strike, hard landing, belly landing, icing, explosion, or runway overrun.
导致飞机结构损伤的因素包括鸟击、外物吸入（FOD）、雷击、强颠簸、地面相撞、擦机尾、重着陆、机腹着陆、积冰、爆炸或跑道冲出。

cards.audioText: Do you have any experience of aircraft structural damage?
cards.audioTextZh: 你遇到过飞机结构损坏吗？
cards.referenceText:
No, I’ve never encountered aircraft structural damage.
不，我从未遇到过飞机结构损坏的情况。

cards.audioText: When do you make an emergency descent?
cards.audioTextZh: 你什么时候会进行紧急下降？
cards.referenceText:
There are many conditions we will make emergency descent. First, if we encounter depressurization during flight, we will make emergency descent. Second, if there is smoke or fire onboard such as engine fire, cabin fire, we will carry out emergency descent.
我们会在多种情况下进行紧急下降。首先，如果在飞行过程中遇到机舱失压，我们会进行紧急下降。其次，如果机舱内出现烟雾或火情，如发动机起火、机舱起火，我们也会进行紧急下降。

Emergency descent is required when encountering decompression, uncontrollable in-flight fire/smoke, pressurization system malfunction, air conditioning failure causing extreme cabin temperature, or bomb threat. It aims to quickly reach a safe altitude or land at the nearest airport to mitigate risks.
遇到以下情况需执行紧急下降：失压、无法控制的机上火情/烟雾、增压系统故障、空调失效导致客舱温度极端、炸弹威胁等。其目的是快速抵达安全高度或在最近机场着陆，以降低风险。

cards.audioText: What procedures should you follow when making an emergency descent/?
cards.audioTextZh: 进行紧急下降时，你应该遵循哪些程序？
cards.referenceText:
When conducting an emergency descent: First, if time allows, report the situation to ATC and request emergency descent clearance. Second, complete the recall items checklist. Third, set the thrust levers to idle. Then, follow the aircraft’s emergency descent profile, monitor instruments, and communicate with crew.
进行紧急下降时：首先，若时间允许，向 ATC 报告情况并申请紧急下降许可；其次，完成记忆项目检查单；第三，将推力杆收至慢车。随后，遵循飞机紧急下降剖面，监控仪表并与机组沟通 。

First, don oxygen mask, notify crew and passengers. Set transponder to 7700, turn on all exterior lights. Turn away from assigned route (if safe) to avoid traffic. Descend at near-max speed with idle thrust and speed brakes extended. Monitor traffic via TCAS/visual check. Coordinate with ATC and land at the nearest suitable airport.
首先佩戴氧气面罩，通知机组和乘客；应答机编码设置为7700，开启所有外部灯光；在安全前提下偏离指定航线以避开其他飞机；以接近最大速度下降，推力调至慢车并伸出减速板；通过防撞系统（TCAS）/目视监控交通；与空管协调，在最近的合适机场着陆。

cards.audioText: What help you get from ATC while emergency descent?
cards.audioTextZh: 在紧急下降过程中，你从空中交通管制（ATC）获得了哪些帮助？
cards.referenceText:
The ATC can offer us some help while executing emergency descent. First, ATC will offer us the clearance to execute the emergency descent. Second, ATC will remind other aircraft emergency descent in progress and give way to us. Third, ATC will offer us the flight conditions and enroute minimum altitude and so on.
在执行紧急下降时，空中交通管制（ATC）可以为我们提供一些帮助。首先，ATC会为我们提供执行紧急下降的许可。其次，ATC会提醒其他正在进行紧急下降的飞机，并让我们先行。第三，ATC会向我们提供飞行条件和航路最低高度等信息。

cards.audioText: What are the possible reasons for belly landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机机腹着陆的可能原因是什么？
cards.referenceText:
There are many possible reasons for belly landing. First, the pilot may forget to extend the landing gear during landing. Second, the mechanical problem may prevent the pilot from extending the landing gear. In these situations, we have to make a belly landing.
飞机机腹着陆可能有很多原因。首先，飞行员在降落过程中可能忘记放下起落架。其次，机械故障可能使飞行员无法放下起落架。在这些情况下，我们不得不进行机腹着陆。

cards.audioText: How do you prepare for a belly landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何为机腹着陆做准备？
cards.referenceText:
If we have to make a belly landing, first, we will report our situation to ATC and request emergency landing and emergency services such as foamed runway, fire services, medical services and so on. Second, we will hold somewhere to burn fuel to reduce the weight of aircraft, reduce the landing speed of the aircraft and reduce the risk of fire upon landing.
如果我们必须进行机腹降落，首先，我们会向空中交通管制（ATC）报告情况，并请求紧急降落和紧急服务，如泡沫跑道、消防服务、医疗服务等。其次，我们会选择一个地方等待，以消耗燃油来减轻飞机重量，降低飞机着陆速度，并减少着陆时发生火灾的风险。

cards.audioText: Do you think belly landing is very dangerous?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为机腹着陆很危险吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I think belly landing is very dangerous. First, it may cause structural damage to the aircraft. Second, it may cause fire on board. Third, it may cause persons on board injured.
是的，我认为机腹着陆非常危险。首先，它可能会对飞机造成结构性损坏。其次，它可能会导致机上发生火灾。第三，这可能会导致机上人员受伤。

cards.audioText: What factors will you take into considerations before making a belly landing？
cards.audioTextZh: 在进行机腹着陆之前，你会考虑哪些因素
cards.referenceText:
There are many factors we will consider before making a belly landing such as the weight of the aircraft, the landing speed of the aircraft, the weather conditions, the runway conditions, the ground services and so on
在进行机腹着陆之前，我们会考虑许多因素，如飞机的重量、飞机的着陆速度、天气状况、跑道状况、地面服务等

cards.audioText: What will you do if you have to make belly landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你必须进行机腹着陆，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If we have to make a belly landing, first, we will report our situation to ATC and request emergency landing and emergency services such as foamed runway, fire services, medical services and so on. Second, we will hold somewhere to burn fuel to reduce the weight of aircraft, reduce the landing speed of the aircraft and reduce the risk of fire upon landing. After landing, we will execute emergency evacuation.
如果我们必须进行机腹着陆，首先，我们将向空中交通管制部门报告我们的情况，并要求紧急着陆和紧急服务，如泡沫跑道、消防、医疗服务等。其次，我们将在某处燃烧燃料，以减轻飞机的重量，降低飞机的着陆速度，降低着陆时发生火灾的风险。着陆后，我们将进行紧急疏散。

cards.audioText: What will you do if you have to make ditching？
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你必须迫降，你会怎么做
cards.referenceText:
If we have to make a ditching, we will report our situation to ATC and request emergency services after ditching. Then we will complete the ditching checklist and inform the cabin crew and passengers to make preparation for ditching such as wearing the lifevest and follow the route of emergency evacuation. Upon ditching, we will follow the instructions of rescuers to leave the aircraft as quickly as we can.
如果我们必须进行迫降，我们将在迫降后向空管报告我们的情况并请求紧急服务。然后，我们将完成迫降检查表，并通知机组人员和乘客做好迫降准备，如穿救生衣，并遵循紧急疏散路线。迫降后，我们将按照救援人员的指示尽快离开飞机。

cards.audioText: When is it necessary to execute emergency evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 何时需要执行紧急疏散？
cards.referenceText:
There are many situations in which we will execute an emergency evacuation. First, if there is fire on board such as engine fire, cabin fire, cockpit fire, we will execute emergency evacuation. Second, if there is a bomb on board, we will carry out emergency evacuation. Third, after emergency landing such as forced landing or belly landing, we will make emergency evacuation.
在许多情况下，我们将执行紧急疏散。首先，如果机上发生火灾，如发动机火灾、机舱火灾、驾驶舱火灾，我们将执行紧急疏散。第二，如果机上有炸弹，我们将进行紧急疏散。第三，在迫降或腹降等紧急降落后，我们将进行紧急疏散。

Emergency evacuation is necessary if there is uncontrollable fire/smoke, severe structural damage, serious fuel leak, forced landing, identified bomb, or any situation threatening crew/passenger lives.
当出现无法控制的火情/烟雾、严重结构损伤、大量燃油泄漏、迫降、确认有爆炸物或其他威胁机组和乘客生命的情况时，需执行紧急撤离。

cards.audioText: How fast should you execute the emergency evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你应该以多快的速度执行紧急疏散？
cards.referenceText:
We should execute the emergency evacuation as soon as possible if an emergency evacuation is required, According to the regulation, in case of fire on board, we should evacuate the passengers in 90 seconds.
如果需要紧急疏散，我们应该尽快执行紧急疏散。根据规定，如果船上发生火灾，我们应该在90秒内疏散乘客。

cards.audioText: What are the procedures of executing emergency evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 执行紧急疏散的程序是什么？
cards.referenceText:
First, we will report our intention to ATC that will we will execute emergency evacuation. Second, we will make a PA to inform cabin crew and passengers that we will make emergency evacuation. Third，we will complete the emergency evacuation checklist. Fourth, the cabin crew will open the emergency exits and emergency slides and lead the passengers to leave the aircraft in time and in order. We will be the last one to leave the aircraft.
首先，我们将向空中交通管制部门报告我们将执行紧急疏散的意图。其次，我们将发出广播，通知机组人员和乘客我们将进行紧急疏散。第三，我们将完成紧急疏散检查表。第四，机组人员将打开紧急出口和紧急滑梯，引导乘客及时有序地离开飞机。我们将是最后一个离开飞机的人。

Stop the aircraft, set parking brakes, cut off engines and power. Inform cabin crew to prepare evacuation, report to ATC and request fire/medical assistance. Instruct passengers to brace for impact, open emergency exits, and guide orderly evacuation.
停稳飞机，设置停留刹车，关闭发动机和电源；通知客舱机组准备撤离，向空管报告并请求消防/医疗支援；指示乘客做好防撞准备，打开紧急出口，引导有序撤离。

cards.audioText: What can you help flight attendants execute emergency evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能帮助空乘人员执行紧急疏散吗？
cards.referenceText:
First, we will make a PA to inform the passengers to make preparation for emergency evacuation and the route of emergency evacuation. After completing the emergency evacuation checklist， we will help the flight attendants to evacuate the passengers.
首先，我们将制作广播，通知乘客做好紧急疏散准备和紧急疏散路线。完成紧急疏散检查表后，我们将帮助空乘人员疏散乘客。

cards.audioText: Do you have the emergency evacuation training with the flight attendants?
cards.audioTextZh: 你和乘务员一起接受过紧急疏散培训吗？
cards.referenceText:
I am a student Pilot have never trained with flight attendants for emergency' evacuation. But I know we should keep good communication and cooperation to ensure the passengers evacuate the aircraft in order and in time.
我是一名学生飞行员，从未与空乘人员一起接受过紧急疏散培训。但我知道我们应该保持良好的沟通与合作，以确保乘客有序及时撤离飞机。

cards.audioText: Who should be the last one to leave the aircraft in case of emergency situations?
cards.audioTextZh: 在紧急情况下，谁应该最后一个离开飞机？
cards.referenceText:
According to the regulations, the captain should be the last one to leave the aircraft in case of emergency situations.
根据规定，在紧急情况下，机长应最后一个离开飞机。

cards.audioText: Under what circumstances do you declare medical emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么情况下，你会宣布医疗紧急情况？
cards.referenceText:
There are many conditions/situations in which we will declare medical emergency. First, if the pilot gets incapacitated, we will declare medical emergency. Second, if the passenger gets seriously ill such as heart attack, we will declare medical emergency. Third, if the passengers get seriously injured, we will declare medical emergency.
在许多情况下，我们会宣布医疗紧急状态。首先，如果飞行员丧失能力，我们将宣布医疗紧急情况。其次，如果乘客患上心脏病等严重疾病，我们将宣布医疗紧急情况。第三，如果乘客严重受伤，我们将宣布医疗紧急情况。

I declare medical emergency when crew or passengers face life-threatening situations, such as severe injuries, heart attacks, unconsciousness, or uncontrollable bleeding. It’s also required if a medical professional on board confirms the situation is critical, needing immediate ground medical assistance.
当机组或乘客遭遇危及生命的状况时会宣布医疗紧急情况，例如重伤、心脏病发作、昏迷或无法控制的出血。若机上专业医护人员确认情况危急，需立即获得地面医疗援助，也需宣布。

cards.audioText: What would you do if you have passengers injured due to turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果乘客因颠簸而受伤，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If the passengers get injured due turbulence, first, we will ask the flight attendants to offer first aid to him. Second, we will make a PA to find a doctor on board. Third, we will report our situation to ATC and request land at nearest suitable airport and medical services.
如果乘客因颠簸受伤，首先，我们会要求空乘人员对他进行急救。其次，我们将通过PA在机上找到一名医生。第三，我们将向空中交通管制部门报告我们的情况，并要求在最近的合适机场降落和医疗服务。

First, I maintain stable flight control. Then, I ask cabin crew to provide first aid and find a doctor on board. I inform ATC of the situation, request priority landing and ambulance at the destination, ensuring the injured passenger gets timely medical treatment.
首先保持飞机稳定操纵，随后让客舱机组为受伤乘客提供急救并寻找机上医生。向空管通报情况，申请优先降落及目的地机场救护车待命，确保受伤乘客及时获得医疗救治。

cards.audioText: If one passenger suffered from heart attack during flight, what would you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果一名乘客在飞行中心脏病发作，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If one passenger suffered from heart attack, first, we will ask the flight attendants to offer first aid to him. Second, we will make a PA to find a doctor on board. Third, we will report our situation to ATC and request land at nearest suitable airport and medical services.
如果一名乘客心脏病发作，首先，我们会要求空乘人员对他进行急救。其次，我们将通过PA在机上找到一名医生。第三，我们将向空中交通管制部门报告我们的情况，并要求在最近的合适机场降落和医疗服务。

cards.audioText: How do you carry out first-aid to persons on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们如何对机上人员进行急救？
cards.referenceText:
If the person on board needs first aid, the flight attendants can offer him or her oxygen supply. Then we will make a PA to find a doctor on board. Finally, we will report our situation to ATC and request land at nearest suitable airport and medical services.
如果机上人员需要急救，乘务员可以为其提供氧气。然后我们会做一个机长广播，在机上找一个医生。最后，我们将向空中交通管制部门报告我们的情况，并要求在最近的合适机场降落和医疗服务。

cards.audioText: What are the differences between urgency and distress situations?
cards.audioTextZh: 紧急情况和遇险情况有什么区别？
cards.referenceText:
There are some differences between urgency and distress situations. The urgency situation does not need immediate assistance from the ATC, the captain will call PANPAN in these situations, such as passenger illness or slow depressurization. The distress situation needs immediate assistance from the ATC, the captain will call MAYDAY in these situations, such as total engine failure, fire on board or bomb explosion on board.
紧急情况和遇险情况之间存在一些差异。紧急情况不需要空中交通管制的立即援助，在这种情况下，如乘客生病或减压缓慢，机长将呼叫PANPAN。遇险情况需要空中交通管制的立即援助，在这些情况下，如发动机完全故障、机上起火或机上炸弹爆炸，机长将呼叫MAYDAY。

Urgency (PAN PAN) refers to situations requiring prompt attention but not immediate danger (such as fuel shortage, sick passenger). Distress (MAYDAY) is more severe, involving immediate threat to life or aircraft (such as fire, engine failure, hijack).
紧急情况（PAN PAN）指需要及时处理但无即时危险的情况（如燃油短缺、乘客生病）；遇险情况（MAYDAY）更为严重，涉及生命或飞机的即时威胁（如火情、发动机失效、劫持）。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered any urgency or distress situations?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否遇到过任何紧急或遇险的情况？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never encountered any urgency or distress situations.

cards.audioText: What would you do in case of emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 万一发生紧急情况，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
In case of emergency. I will keep control of the aircraft, ask the copilot to read the checklist, and l will do the operations. At the same time, I will report this situation to ATC, request diversion or priority to landing and emergency services,
在紧急情况下。我会控制飞机，让副驾驶阅读检查单，然后我会进行操作。同时，我将向空中交通管制部门报告这一情况，请求改道或优先降落和紧急服务，

cards.audioText: Please give an example or describe the steps you may take in urgency or distress situations?
cards.audioTextZh: 请举一个例子或描述你在紧急或遇险中可能采取的步骤？
cards.referenceText:
For example, if I encounter the rapid depressurization, I will put on the oxygen mask, try my best to control the aircraft, ask the copilot to report to ATC, request immediate descent to minimum safe altitude. Then, I will request priority landing, and all possible ground emergency services.
例如，如果我遇到快速减压，我会戴上氧气面罩，尽力控制飞机，要求副驾驶向空中交通管制报告，要求立即下降到最低安全高度。然后，我将请求优先降落，以及所有可能的地面紧急服务。

cards.audioText: What support do you need from ATC or ground personnel in emergency situations?
cards.audioTextZh: 在紧急情况下，你需要空中交通管制或地面人员提供哪些支持？
cards.referenceText:
In emergency situations, the ATC or ground personnel will give us all the possible ground services, such as fire services, medical services, airport police and rescue and so on.
在紧急情况下，空中交通管制或地面人员将为我们提供所有可能的地面服务，如消防服务、医疗服务、机场警察和救援等。

cards.audioText: Who should be the last one to leave the aircraft in the emergency situations? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 在紧急情况下，谁应该是最后一个离开飞机的人？为什么？
cards.referenceText:
The captain should be the last one to leave the aircraft in the emergency situations. Captain has the highest duties to the safety of this flight. After emergency evacuation, the captain will do the cabin check to ensure everyone has left the aircraft．He will be the last one to leave the aircraft.
在紧急情况下，机长应该是最后一个离开飞机的人。机长对这次飞行的安全负有最高责任。紧急疏散后，机长将进行机舱检查，以确保所有人都已离开飞机。他将是最后一个离开飞机的人。

cards.audioText:
How do pilots make a distress
transmitting?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何进行遇险呼叫？
cards.referenceText:
The distress transmission shall begin with the signal MAYDAY three times. Then the pilot shall report to ATC what has happened, how serious it is, what’s his intention and what kind of assistance is required and other useful information.
遇险呼叫需以 “MAYDAY” 信号开头，连续呼叫三次；随后向空管报告事件情况、严重程度、自身意图、所需援助及其他有用信息。

cards.audioText:
What should you do when you hear one
aircraft making a distress transmission
during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中听到其他飞机的遇险呼叫，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If the distress aircraft can communicate with ATC, I will stop transmitting. If not, I will help to relay the message to ATC and provide necessary assistance.
若遇险飞机可与空管正常通信，将停止通话以避免干扰；若无法通信，将协助向空管转发信息并提供必要援助。

cards.audioText: Did you review emergency procedures in simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞模拟机时候接受过紧急程序吗?
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I reviewed various emergency procedures in simulator training, including engine failure, depressurization, fire, bird strike, runway incursion, and evacuation. The training focused on SOP compliance, decision-making, and crew coordination to handle emergencies calmly and ensure flight safety.
是的，我在模拟机训练中复习过多种紧急程序，包括发动机失效、释压、火情、鸟击、跑道入侵和撤离等。训练重点是遵循标准操作程序（SOP）、决策制定和机组协作，以冷静处置紧急情况，保障飞行安全。

cards.audioText: What do you think are the principles of evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为紧急撤离的重要原则有哪些?
cards.referenceText:
Key principles of emergency evacuation include: prioritizing safety (avoiding fire/smoke); speed (evacuating within 90 seconds); order (guiding passengers calmly); crew responsibility (captain as last to leave); using correct exits (avoiding blocked ones); and coordinating with cabin crew to ensure all passengers are evacuated.
紧急撤离的核心原则包括：安全优先（避开火/烟雾）；快速撤离（90秒内完成）；秩序井然（引导乘客保持冷静）；机组职责（机长最后撤离）；选择正确出口（避开堵塞出口）；与客舱机组协作，确保所有乘客撤离完毕。

cards.audioText: What are the duties of cabin crew during emergency evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 紧急撤离时机组的职责有哪些?
cards.referenceText:
During emergency evacuation, cabin crew duties include: guiding passengers to exits calmly; assisting vulnerable passengers (children, elderly); opening emergency exits and deploying slides; maintaining order to avoid stampedes; checking cabins for remaining passengers; coordinating with flight crew; and reporting evacuation status to the captain.
紧急撤离时，客舱机组的职责包括：冷静引导乘客前往出口；协助弱势乘客（儿童、老人）；打开紧急出口并展开滑梯；维持秩序防止踩踏；检查客舱是否有滞留乘客；与飞行机组协作；向机长报告撤离情况。
